question: ClinicalTrials.gov lists 'Levine Cancer Center, Charlotte' as a site on NCT05730036. Is your site currently activated for this trial?
If activated: how many participants has your site randomized to date?
Name of the proposed (or current) Principal Investigator for this trial
How many patients per year do you see with RRMM after 1-4 prior lines (lenalidomide- and PI-exposed) who have had no prior pomalidomide, elotuzumab or BCMA-directed T-cell therapy?
How many participants do you expect to randomize per month?
For overlapping patients, how would you rank this trial against QUINTESSENTIAL-2 (NCT06615479)?
Can you admit participants for 24 h after each of the first two step-up doses with less than 1 week's notice?
Is tocilizumab stocked on-site and available within 2 hours of a CRS order?
Is your site (pharmacy and healthcare setting) certified in the commercial LYNOZYFIC REMS?
Are your prescribers and pharmacy certified in the PS-Pomalidomide REMS?
Does your infusion center have capacity for weekly elotuzumab infusions (about 2-3 h each) in cycles 1-2?
Can you process and freeze serum for PK/ADA at -70 C or colder on-site?
Can you ship fresh bone marrow aspirate to a central MRD lab on the day it is collected?
Is PET-CT or whole-body low-dose CT available for extramedullary disease assessment within 14 days of an order?
Which IRB would be the IRB of record for this trial?
What is your typical time, in days, from receiving a draft contract and budget to signing it?
